unit.title: Multiplication and Division (2)
unit.blurb: Multiplying and dividing decimals by whole numbers, and multiplying and dividing fractions by whole numbers.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Estimate and multiply numbers with one or two decimal places by whole numbers.

O2.t: Multiply and divide proper fractions by whole numbers.

O3.t: Estimate and divide numbers with one or two decimal places by whole numbers.

p: To work out 2.4 × 3, think 24 × 3 = 72, then put the decimal point back: **7.2**. The answer has the same number of decimal places as the decimal.
0.3 × 4 = 1.2, not 0.12. Only one decimal place is in the question, so only one in the answer.

p: 2/5 × 3 means three lots of 2/5: 2/5 + 2/5 + 2/5 = **6/5 = 1 1/5**. Multiply the numerator by the whole number.
To divide a fraction by a whole number, multiply the **denominator**: 3/4 ÷ 2 = **3/8**.
2/5 × 3 is 6/5, not 6/15. The size of the parts (fifths) does not change.
